findings.message: Module instance replication_role (./modules/replication_role) has no compliancetf-manifest.json; it is listed as not-evidence, never as covered
Module instance replication_role is not served by compliance.tf; the catalog names bobthecorp.compliance.tf/terraform-aws-modules/iam/aws as the replacement
